title: Backup scope · browser
expect: Open View Album from an album context menu or accessibility action.
The read-only browser uses a native navigation title, system Back and the production library grid when photos are accessible.
Catalogs without PhotoKit access show the production permission state.

actions.action: Search for Family, open View Album, then use system Back.
actions.result: Return restores Family search, selection and list position; browsing registers no work.
